critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the upper deck primitive to extend its longitudinal length by 40% toward the rear of the fuselage. Apply a 15-degree taper to the width of this section as it moves posteriorly, and increase its vertical height by 20%. Finally, replace the sharp junction with a fillet radius of 3 units where the upper deck meets the main fuselage to create a smooth transition.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck section ends abruptly near the middle of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck extends significantly further back toward the rear of the aircraft.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Increase length along the longitudinal axis

discrepancies.observed: A sharp, angular transition where the upper deck meets the main fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous curve from the nose to the end of the hump.

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears relatively flat and low compared to the main fuselage diameter.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent, rounded protrusion that rises significantly above the main cabin line.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Increase vertical scale of the upper deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The top of the hump remains wide until it cuts off.
discrepancies.reference: The hump tapers gradually toward its rear terminus.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Taper the width of the upper deck geometry towards the rear
